sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The collapse of a residential tower in Surfside, Florida, which killed at least 11 residents, has raised two urgent questions.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州瑟夫赛德一栋住宅楼的倒塌已造成至少 11 名居民死亡，这引发了两个紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: What caused it?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致了这一事故？

sentences.en: And why is it that so many days later, 150 people are still missing?
sentences.zh: 为什么时隔这么多天，仍有 150 人失踪？

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Miami Bureau Chief Patty Mazze.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、迈阿密分社社长帕蒂·马齐。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 6 月 29 日，星期二。

sentences.en: Hey, Patty.
sentences.zh: 嘿，帕蒂。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Are you in your car?
sentences.zh: 你在车里吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在。

sentences.en: And it's actually raining pretty hard right now.
sentences.zh: 事实上现在雨下得挺大的。

sentences.en: And where exactly are you right now in your car?
sentences.zh: 你现在具体在车里的什么位置？

sentences.en: I am a few blocks south of the Champlain Towers building that collapsed.
sentences.zh: 我在倒塌的尚普兰塔楼建筑以南几个街区。

sentences.en: There's a lot of road closures.
sentences.zh: 有很多道路封闭。

sentences.en: They've sort of expanded them as the days have gone by.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们差不多扩大了封闭范围。

sentences.en: So every day we've been able to get less close to the building.
sentences.zh: 所以每天我们离那栋建筑的距离都变得更远一点。

sentences.en: And can you describe, I don't know if you can see it from your car, but can you describe the state of the towers right now, what they look like?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下吗，我不知道你从车里能不能看到，但你能描述一下塔楼现在的状态，它们看起来怎么样吗？

sentences.en: Imagine a 13-story building with more than 130 units that has had about half of it sheared off and just crumbled into the ground.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，一栋拥有 130 多套单元的 13 层建筑，其中大约有一半被削掉并直接崩塌在地面上。

sentences.en: It's a jumble by the beach side of concrete and metal and furniture.
sentences.zh: 海滩边是一堆杂乱的混凝土、金属和家具。

sentences.en: And you can see straight into these exposed apartments, frozen in time, people's homes, their beds, their office chairs, their linens, just sticking out and waving in the
sentences.zh: 你可以直接看到这些暴露在外的公寓，时间仿佛定格在了那里，人们的家、床、办公椅、床单，就那样突兀地伸出来，在

sentences.en: wind with the whole recovery operation around them and the big cranes and the rescue workers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 风中飘扬，周围则是整个搜救行动、巨大的起重机和到处都是救援人员。

sentences.en: Well, that's what we really want to talk to you about because it has now been four full days since the collapse.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是我们真正想跟你谈的，因为距离倒塌发生现在已经整整四天了。

sentences.en: We're talking to you on Monday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我们是在周一下午和你通话。

sentences.en: And it feels like a central question in this unfolding tragedy is why the pace of finding people has been so slow.
sentences.zh: 这场不断演变的悲剧的核心问题似乎是，为什么搜救人员的进展如此缓慢。

sentences.en: So can you help us understand why recovering the missing has been taking so long?
sentences.zh: 所以你能帮我们理解一下，为什么搜寻失踪人员需要这么长时间吗？

sentences.en: You know, at the beginning, it wasn't so slow.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一开始并没有这么慢。

sentences.en: They were able to rescue some people.
sentences.zh: 他们成功搜救了一些人。

sentences.en: This building partly collapsed at around 1.30 in the morning on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑是在周四凌晨 1 点 30 分左右部分倒塌的。

sentences.en: And one of the first things that we know happened was that people who were still out in the street at that time, nearby, rushed over to see, and they heard a boy screaming.
sentences.zh: 我们知道发生的第一批事情之一就是，当时还在街上、附近的市民冲过来查看，他们听到一个男孩在尖叫。

sentences.en: And they saw his hand sticking out from the rubble, his fingers wriggling in the air.
sentences.zh: 他们看到他的手从废墟中伸出来，手指在空中扭动着。

sentences.en: And they tried to climb the rubble in flip-flops in the middle of the night themselves to try to help him.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至在半夜穿着人字拖试图自己爬上废墟去救他。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Eventually, they were able to flag down a police officer and a firefighter to actually get the kid out.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们成功拦住了一名警察和一名消防员，才把这名儿童救了出来。

sentences.en: And he was saved.
sentences.zh: 他得救了。

sentences.en: We also know that rescue crews later were able to help two other people, a mother and a daughter, who had been in the ninth floor when the collapse happened,
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，救援人员后来能够帮助另外两个人，一对母女，倒塌发生时她们在九楼，

sentences.en: and somehow tumbled down to the fifth floor.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的跌落到了五楼。

sentences.en: And the mother suffered various fractures and was somehow able to find her daughter despite being seriously injured.
sentences.zh: 母亲受了各种骨折，尽管身受重伤，还是设法找到了女儿。

sentences.en: And they found those two women and sent them to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了这两名女性并将她们送往医院。

sentences.en: After that, though, things did get a lot slower.
sentences.zh: 不过在那之后，事情确实变得慢得多了。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: There's basically two issues.
sentences.zh: 基本上有两个问题。

sentences.en: One is just the nature of this rescue and of this collapse.
sentences.zh: 一个是这次救援和倒塌本身的性质。

sentences.en: And the other is the conditions that the workers are living through on the ground in the depths of the Miami summer.
sentences.zh: 另一个是工人们在迈阿密盛夏酷暑的底层地面上所经历的恶劣条件。

sentences.en: So, first of all, part of this building stayed up, but more than half of these more than 130 units pancake down on each other, leaving an unstable pile of concrete and rebar and
sentences.zh: 首先，这栋建筑的一部分留存了下来，但超过一半的 130 多个单元像叠煎饼一样层层坍塌压在一起，留下了一堆不稳定的混凝土、钢筋、

sentences.en: metal and furniture and debris.
sentences.zh: 金属、家具和碎片。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then there's the weather.
sentences.zh: 然后是天气。

sentences.en: In June in Miami, it's incredibly hot and humid.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密的六月，异常炎热潮湿。

sentences.en: But also, there have been rolling thunderstorms in the days of rescue.
sentences.zh: 而且，在搜救的这几天里，雷暴天气接连不断。

sentences.en: The lightning sometimes means a delay in the rescue for the safety of the workers.
sentences.zh: 为了工人们的安全，闪电有时意味着救援必须延迟。

sentences.en: The rain just makes the conditions harder for them to work in.
sentences.zh: 雨水只是让他们的工作环境变得更加艰难。

sentences.en: And they have been facing fires within the structure that they have to try to put out for their own safety and sometimes delay putting out for their own safety.
sentences.zh: 为了自身安全，他们必须设法扑灭建筑内部的火灾，有时为了自身安全又不得不推迟灭火。

sentences.en: Because if they put these high-pressure water hoses on the fire, they add a lot of weight and pressure to the structure that is unstable.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们用这些高压水带对着火灾喷水，就会给本来就不稳定的结构增加大量的重量和压力。

sentences.en: So, given those two factors you just described, how exactly are they going about trying to find these dozens of missing people?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于你刚才描述的这两个因素，他们究竟是如何着手寻找这几十名失踪人员的？

sentences.en: After they did an initial sweep floor by floor of what was left of the building to make sure there
sentences.zh: 在对建筑物的残余部分逐层进行初步搜查以确保

sentences.en: weren't people there, they figured out that the likeliest place for people to have maybe survived
sentences.zh: 那里没有人的情况之后，他们发现在建筑物倒塌时有时会形成的空隙（即所谓的空洞）中，

sentences.en: in what they call voids, which are empty spaces that form sometimes when buildings fall down, was towards the bottom of the wreckage.
sentences.zh: 人们可能生还的最可能地点是在残骸的底部。

sentences.en: So, they tried to tunnel in through what was left of the parking garage, and they drilled and shored up the concrete so that workers could go in there.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们试图通过停车场残存的部分打通隧道，并对混凝土进行钻孔和加固，以便工人们能够进入。

sentences.en: Those conditions were also difficult because there was flooding.
sentences.zh: 这些条件同样十分艰难，因为这里有积水。

sentences.en: And so, they were wading through thigh-deep water, in some cases, in the dark, trying to listen with specialized equipment for signs of life.
sentences.zh: 因此，在某些情况下，他们在黑暗中蹚着没大腿深的积水，试图用专业设备倾听生命迹象。

sentences.en: In a particularly horrible scene, we know that on Thursday, they briefly heard the sounds of what they thought was a woman's voice.
sentences.zh: 在一个特别可怕的场景中，我们知道在周四，他们短暂地听到了一声他们认为是女性声音的声音。

sentences.en: But they, you know, stopped hearing it shortly after, and they didn't rescue anybody.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，没过多久他们就听不到了，也没有救出任何人。

sentences.en: And how does that work?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的呢？

sentences.en: How are they actually able to try to hear these potential survivors?
sentences.zh: 他们究竟是如何设法听到这些潜在幸存者的声音的？

sentences.en: We know that at these sites, one of the things they do is call for quiet, for silence, when they are sort of pushing through and then trying to listen.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在这些现场，他们所做的事情之一就是在推进并试图倾听时，要求保持安静。

sentences.en: They're not just looking for voices, they're looking for other signs of life, which can include someone tapping, or scratching, or twisting metal, or
sentences.zh: 他们不仅在寻找声音，还在寻找其他生命迹象，这可能包括敲击、抓挠、扭曲金属，或者

sentences.en: trying to move around to try to get the attention of rescuers.
sentences.zh: 试图四处移动以引起救援人员的注意。

sentences.en: So, they have listening devices and sonar devices and video cameras that they probe through holes to try to see their way through.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们有监听设备、声纳设备和视频摄像头，可以通过孔洞进行探查，以此寻找通路。

sentences.en: After they tried that approach, and they did not rescue anybody, then they started moving towards the top of the pile.
sentences.zh: 在尝试了这种方法却没有救出任何人之后，他们开始向废墟顶部移动。

sentences.en: They had brought in the heavy machinery by then.
sentences.zh: 到那时他们已经运来了重型机械。

sentences.en: They don't clear big pieces of debris until they have cleared a section at a time to make sure that there are no remains there.
sentences.zh: 在逐个区域清理完毕以确保那里没有遗体之前，他们是不会清理大块废墟的。

sentences.en: So, you can imagine the sort of painstaking process this is.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象这是一个多么费力的过程。

sentences.en: Eventually, they were able to dig a sort of trench, cutting through, demarcating the wreckage, so that they could keep track of where they had been and where they had not been.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们设法挖出了一条类似战壕的通道，切割并划分了残骸，这样他们就能记录自己去过哪里，没去过哪里。

sentences.en: And that's where you see this cross-section of what were once floors of the building.
sentences.zh: 这就是你看到曾经是大楼楼层的横截面的地方。

sentences.en: And it's really striking because there is so little space between the slabs that were once the floor and the ceiling, and the floor and the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 这真的很显眼，因为曾经作为楼层和天花板、楼层和天花板的板块之间空间太小了。

sentences.en: And we're now talking of maybe a couple of feet, maybe less, between each one.
sentences.zh: 现在我们说的是每个楼层之间可能只有几英尺，甚至更少。

sentences.en: So, what used to be regular-sized apartments are now separated by a foot or two.
sentences.zh: 因此，过去尺寸正常的公寓现在只隔了一两英尺。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the idea is that possibly people are stuck between those.
sentences.zh: 人们认为可能有人被困在这些空隙之间。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, as horrifying as that is, yes.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，尽管这很可怕，但确实如此。

sentences.en: And Patty, have you been able to speak with any of the rescue workers?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，你有没有跟任何救援人员交谈过？

sentences.en: I have to a couple of them.
sentences.zh: 我和其中几个人聊过。

sentences.en: They've brought in specialized groups that are really the experts at urban search and rescue.
sentences.zh: 他们调来了专业团队，这些团队确实是城市搜救的专家。

sentences.en: And families were frustrated at first because they wanted to make sure that absolutely everything was being done to find their loved ones, and they weren't sure that was the case.
sentences.zh: 家属们一开始感到很沮丧，因为他们想确保已经尽了一切努力去寻找他们挚爱的亲人，而他们并不确定事实是否如此。

sentences.en: And so, on Sunday, they actually gave the families who wanted it a chance to rotate in and
sentences.zh: 因此，在周日，他们实际上给了那些希望如此的家属一个机会，让他们轮流

sentences.en: out near the site, to see it for themselves in private, without politicians, without reporters,
sentences.zh: 进入现场附近，在没有政治家、没有记者的私人情况下亲眼看看它，

sentences.en: to have a moment to witness the search and rescue, and also, in some cases, to grieve, to pray, to just
sentences.zh: 留出一段时间来见证搜救工作，在某些情况下还可以进行哀悼、祈祷和反思，

sentences.en: reflect, so that they could see sort of this labyrinth that the workers are going through, and the
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能看到工人们正在经历的这种迷宫般的废墟，以及

sentences.en: hundreds of people that are working through this base camp and on the site to try to find, you know, survivors for their remains.
sentences.zh: 成百上千的人在这个大本营和现场努力寻找幸存者或遗骸的工作。

sentences.en: And now, what the rescue workers say they're doing is trying to collect some of the keepsakes and personal items that they come across.
sentences.zh: 现在，救援人员说他们正在做的是收集他们偶然发现的一些纪念品和私人物品。

sentences.en: They are finding artwork, jewelry, stuffed animals, and especially personal photos, family photos.
sentences.zh: 他们正在寻找艺术品、珠宝、毛绒玩具，尤其是个人照片、家庭照片。

sentences.en: And they're collecting them and bagging them so that the families can get
sentences.zh: 他们把这些东西收集起来并装进袋子里，以便家属能够拿到

sentences.en: them and at least have something that, at the end of the day, might really be the only keepsakes that some of these families get from their missing loved ones.
sentences.zh: 它们，至少能拥有一些东西——归根结底，这可能是其中一些家属从他们失踪的亲人那里得到的仅有的纪念品。

sentences.en: Speaking of the families, I'm curious if, in your reporting, you've heard stories about those who are missing that really stand out to you.
sentences.zh: 说到家属，我很好奇在你的采访报道中，你是否听过那些让你印象深刻的失踪人员的故事。

sentences.en: Well, among the people who have been confirmed dead are the parents of a girl I went to high school with.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在被确认死亡的人当中，有我高中同学的父母。

sentences.en: Just to give you an idea of how this touches the community to a very personal level, where most of us, or many of us, have sort of connections in some way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了让你了解这件事是如何以非常个人的方式触动整个社区的，我们大多数人或许多人都在某种程度上与此有着这样或那样的联系。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember picking my friend up in that building one summer, you know, and going in through the back towards the beach.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得有一年夏天去那栋大楼接我的朋友，你知道的，从后面朝海滩方向进去。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I'm very sorry.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常遗憾。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You know, it's people you sort of know indirectly, but it certainly keeps you up at night knowing how they're suffering.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些人你只是间接认识，但一想到他们正在承受的痛苦，确实让你夜不能寐。

sentences.en: There is, you know, there's a family where we know the mother and the young daughter slept in the same bed, and their grandparents also lived with them, and their aunt
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有一个家庭，我们知道母亲和幼小的女儿睡在同一张床上，他们的祖父母也跟他们住在一起，他们的阿姨

sentences.en: was visiting them from Argentina, and all of them are missing.
sentences.zh: 当时正从阿根廷来看望他们，他们全家都失踪了。

sentences.en: Just horrible story after horrible story.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个的故事都是如此可怕。

sentences.en: It's hard, you know, to tell them all.
sentences.zh: 要把它们全讲完很难。

sentences.en: We know that there was a young one from Paraguay who was on her first trip outside of Paraguay to help her family make money, and she was working as a nanny, and she's missing.
sentences.zh: 我们知道有一个来自巴拉圭的年轻人，这是她第一次离开巴拉圭去帮家里赚钱，她当时在当保姆，现在失踪了。

sentences.en: It's a reminder that Miami and the Miami area is such an international place.
sentences.zh: 这提醒了我们，迈阿密及迈阿密地区是一个多么国际化的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is really a slice of South Florida that living here you forget how unusual it
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的是南佛罗里达的一个缩影，住在这里你会忘记这是多么不寻常

sentences.en: is, but this is a building that had retirees and also young families, and there was a lot of South
sentences.zh: 的事，但这栋大楼里既有退休人员，也有年轻家庭，而且有很多南

sentences.en: American families because they have long been present in this part of the country and had maybe
sentences.zh: 美洲家庭，因为他们长期以来一直在这个地区的这部分生活，可能

sentences.en: had those apartments for decades and slowly, you know, used them from vacation homes to now actually living in them.
sentences.zh: 拥有那些公寓几十年了，然后慢慢地，你知道的，把它们从度假屋变成了现在真正居住的家。

sentences.en: There was a strong Orthodox Jewish community here, and they had a lot of members from
sentences.zh: 这里有一个很强的正统犹太人社区，他们的

sentences.en: their congregations in this building, and I think that has just shown you what sort of, like, diverse
sentences.zh: 许多会众成员都住在这栋大楼里，我认为这恰恰展现了居住在那里的是一种什么样的多元化

sentences.en: community lived there and has come together to help them and start to mourn them, too.
sentences.zh: 社区，他们现在聚集在一起互相帮助，并开始悼念逝者。

sentences.en: This is a delicate question, but at this point, is there any expectation that people could have survived this many days in this condition of rubble that you just described?
sentences.zh: 这是一个敏感的问题，但就目前而言，人们是否还期望有人能在你刚才描述的这种废墟状况下存活这么多天？

sentences.en: They are still officially in search and rescue mode, which means they have not lost hope of finding
sentences.zh: 他们目前在官方上仍然处于搜救模式，这意味着他们还没有失去找到

sentences.en: somebody, but as the days and hours tick by, it's become increasingly clear, I think, that even if you get one miracle, you're not going to get 150 of them.
sentences.zh: 某人的希望，但随着日分秒逝，我认为越来越明显的是，即使你能得到一个奇迹，你也不可能得到 150 个奇迹。

sentences.en: So what we're talking about at this point is a form of a mass grave, in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上我们所谈论的，在某种程度上是一种集体坟墓的形式。

sentences.en: What the first responder told me was that bringing families to the site was important because this was the closest some of them were ever going to be to their loved ones again.
sentences.zh: 第一响应者告诉我的原因是，把家属带到现场很重要，因为这是他们中的一些人此生最后一次离亲人这么近了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Patty, let's now turn to the other big question of this tragedy, which is exactly how it happened and what role negligence may have played in this.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，现在让我们转向这场悲剧的另一个重大问题，那就是它究竟是如何发生的，以及疏忽在其中可能扮演了什么角色。

sentences.en: You and our colleagues at the Times have been reporting on a warning that was issued by a building expert and what did or did not happen as a result of that warning.
sentences.zh: 你和我们在《时报》的同事一直在报道一位建筑专家发出的警告，以及由于该警告而发生了什么或没有发生什么。

sentences.en: Can you walk us through that?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们详细梳理一下吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So Miami-Dade County has a rule that buildings have to be recertified as structurally sound when they turn 40 years old.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密-戴德县有一项规定，建筑物在建成 40 年后必须重新进行结构安全认证。

sentences.en: This building was built in 1981, so its review was coming due this year.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑建于 1981 年，因此今年正值其评估期。

sentences.en: But three years before the deadline in 2018, the building hired a consultant to take a look at some of the problems
sentences.zh: 但在截止日期前的三年（即 2018 年），该大楼聘请了一位顾问来查看一些问题

sentences.en: in the building and just get them set up for this inspection that was coming up.
sentences.zh: 在楼里为即将到来的检查做好各项准备。

sentences.en: And this engineer wrote up a report that found evidence of major structural damage, especially to some of the concrete in the slab holding up the pool deck.
sentences.zh: 这位工程师写了一份报告，发现存在严重结构损坏的证据，特别是支撑泳池甲板的混凝土板。

sentences.en: And there was cracking and crumbling of columns and beams and walls of the parking garage under the 13-story building.
sentences.zh: 13层大楼下方的停车场里，柱子、梁和墙壁都出现了开裂和崩塌。

sentences.en: The report did not warn that there was going to be some sort of catastrophic collapse of the building, but it did find that there was millions
sentences.zh: 报告并没有警告说大楼会发生某种灾难性的坍塌，但确实发现有数百万

sentences.en: of dollars worth of repairs that needed to be done soon.
sentences.zh: 美元的维修费用需要尽快投入。

sentences.en: And so someone from the condo board, which is the group of residents elected to run the building, sent it to the building official in the town of
sentences.zh: 因此，公寓董事会（即由居民选出负责管理大楼的组织）的一名成员将其发送给了

sentences.en: Surfside, according to emails released by the town, saying, we have this report.
sentences.zh: 瑟夫赛德镇的建筑官员，根据镇里公开的电子邮件，上面写着：我们有这样一份报告。

sentences.en: Would you meet with us to talk about it?
sentences.zh: 你们能跟我们见面谈谈吗？

sentences.en: And the records show that the building official did go in late 2018 to meet with the condo association to discuss the report?
sentences.zh: 记录显示，这位建筑官员确实在2018年底去与公寓协会会面讨论了这份报告。

sentences.en: Was that an obligation or was this someone kind of blowing the whistle?
sentences.zh: 这是一种职责所在，还是有人在某种程度上进行内部举报？

sentences.en: It's unclear, but what he reported back to town officials and what the condo association
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚，但他向镇官员汇报的内容以及公寓协会

sentences.en: wrote down in the minutes of this meeting was that basically the building was in good shape.
sentences.zh: 在这场会议的会议记录中写下的内容是，基本上这座建筑状况良好。

sentences.en: He did tell the town manager that even though the recertification of the building was not due until 2021, he was
sentences.zh: 他确实告诉镇经理，尽管该建筑的重新认证要到2021年才到期，但他

sentences.en: really happy that it was getting underway early and that he actually wished more buildings would do that too.
sentences.zh: 很高兴这项工作能提前进行，而且他实际上希望更多的建筑也能这样做。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: It feels from everything you're describing that this is a group of well-intentioned leaders in
sentences.zh: 从你描述的一切来看，这似乎是一群充满善意的领导者，

sentences.en: this building and local building official who are all trying to do things the right way.
sentences.zh: 大楼里的居民和当地的建筑官员都在努力以正确的方式做事。

sentences.en: Well, the issue is that after this report comes out and this meeting takes place, nothing immediately happens to get these repairs underway.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题在于，在这份报告出炉并且举行了这次会议之后，并没有立即采取任何行动来推进这些修缮工作。

sentences.en: There seems to be a period of time where they have to figure out how they're going to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 似乎有一段时间，他们必须弄清楚将如何为此支付费用。

sentences.en: We're talking about more than $9 million in repairs, according to the report.
sentences.zh: 根据报告，我们谈论的是超过900万美元的维修费用。

sentences.en: And we know that the building took out a $12 million line of credit to pay for it and had to issue a special assessment to unit owners to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，大楼为此申请了1200万美元的信贷额度，并且不得不向单元业主征收特别摊款来支付这笔费用。

sentences.en: And we're talking, you know, $80,000 to $200,000 per unit.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是，你知道的，每个单元8万到20万美元不等。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And there was pushback from some of the owners about having to pay this huge amount of money for this.
sentences.zh: 一些业主对必须为此支付这笔巨额资金提出了反弹。

sentences.en: And so all of these things happened after they knew that there were issues.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些事情都发生在他们知道存在问题之后。

sentences.en: They just apparently did not know how bad those issues were.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们只是不知道这些问题有多严重。

sentences.en: And it is only now in the summer of 2021 that we know that roof repairs were beginning and starting to take place right before the building collapsed.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，也就是2021年夏天，我们才知道屋顶维修工作在大楼倒塌前夕才刚刚开始进行。

sentences.en: So three years after this report was written, warning of significant problems and repairs that were needed within the building,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在写下这份警告大楼存在重大问题且需要维修的报告三年之后，

sentences.en: the major work had not yet begun when this building collapses.
sentences.zh: 在这栋大楼倒塌时，主要工作甚至还没有开始。

sentences.en: As far as we can tell, yes.
sentences.zh: 就我们所知，是的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And Patty, based on your reporting, does it seem that the way the building collapsed, the manner in which it fell, does that in any way point back to some of the factors and the
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，根据你的报道，大楼倒塌的方式，也就是它垮塌的形式，是否在某种程度上指向了这位顾问三年前指出的某些因素和

sentences.en: deficiencies that this consultant pointed out three years ago?
sentences.zh: 缺陷？

sentences.en: What structural engineers have told us, based on video of the collapse and on this report from 2018,
sentences.zh: 结构工程师根据倒塌的视频以及2018年的这份报告告诉我们，

sentences.en: is that it is possible that something towards the bottom of the building is what led to this collapse.
sentences.zh: 大楼底部的某些问题可能是导致这次倒塌的原因。

sentences.en: And that could be the concrete slab under the pool deck somehow caving in.
sentences.zh: 那可能是泳池甲板下的混凝土板不知何故塌陷了。

sentences.en: We know that there was a woman on the phone who told her husband before the line went dead right at the time of the
sentences.zh: 我们知道，有一位女士在倒塌发生的那一刻，在电话挂断前告诉她的丈夫，

sentences.en: collapse that there was a sort of sinkhole happening on the pool deck by the garage.
sentences.zh: 车库旁边的泳池甲板上正在发生某种天坑塌陷。

sentences.en: And the video shows sort of that part coming down first and then bringing down the other part of the building that fell.
sentences.zh: 视频显示，那部分先塌了下来，然后拖垮了倒塌大楼的其余部分。

sentences.en: And if there were structural problems towards the bottom of the building that were exposing metal
sentences.zh: 如果大楼底部的结构问题导致金属暴露在

sentences.en: to salty air and to water, we know from experts that corrosion in metal in buildings is like a cancer because it starts crumbling the concrete.
sentences.zh: 含盐的空气和水中，我们从专家那里了解到，建筑物中金属的腐蚀就像癌症一样，因为它开始使混凝土崩解。

sentences.en: And did the consultant mention both of those things?
sentences.zh: 顾问是否同时提到了这两点？

sentences.en: Metal being exposed because the concrete had deteriorated and that concrete slab near the pool having problems?
sentences.zh: 由于混凝土老化而导致金属暴露，以及泳池附近的混凝土板存在问题？

sentences.en: One of the problems that the consultant found in 2018 was that the concrete slab where the pool was was not waterproofed correctly in the original design of the building.
sentences.zh: 顾问在2018年发现的问题之一是，最初设计大楼时，泳池所在位置的混凝土板防水做得并不规范。

sentences.en: And so that didn't allow the water to run off and instead it would leak into the garage, which could cause long-term damage to the metal that holds up the concrete.
sentences.zh: 因此，这无法让水排走，反而会渗入车库，这可能会对支撑混凝土的金属造成长期损害。

sentences.en: This slab was above the parking garage that's sort of in the middle of the building with the, you know, 13 stories of apartments overlooking it and connected to it all.
sentences.zh: 这块板位于停车场上方，停车场大致位于大楼中部，你知道的，13层的公寓俯瞰着它并与之相连。

sentences.en: And so if, you know, as one of these theories of what might have happened goes, there was in fact a sort of caving in at that point.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果正如某种可能发生的情况的理论之一所说，当时确实发生了某种塌陷。

sentences.en: From the video, you can see that sort of pulls down the center part of the building and then the sort of northern side of the building that faces the beach comes down right after.
sentences.zh: 从视频中可以看出，这拉拽着大楼的中心部分往下掉，紧接着面向海滩的大楼北部也随之倒塌。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Is anything else potentially at play here that you have found in your reporting?
sentences.zh: 你在报道中发现，这里还可能存在其他潜在因素吗？

sentences.en: We have been told by residents of the building that they were very concerned when another building was
sentences.zh: 大楼居民告诉我们，几年前附近建造另一座大楼时，他们非常担忧，

sentences.en: built nearby a few years ago and they could almost feel shaking when that construction was taking place.
sentences.zh: 施工时他们甚至能感觉到震动。

sentences.en: So that was one concern.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个担忧。

sentences.en: We know by a study from a Florida International University professor that that particular area of Surfside where that specific building was had been sinking a little bit that he
sentences.zh: 我们从佛罗里达国际大学一位教授的研究中得知，瑟夫赛德建有特定建筑的那个特定区域一直在轻微下沉，他在

sentences.en: could detect in the study that he did.
sentences.zh: 自己做的研究中能够检测到这一点。

sentences.en: He cautioned that you don't know that that means a building is going to collapse because buildings sort of sink in different parts of the world all the time.
sentences.zh: 他警告说，这并不意味着大楼一定会倒塌，因为世界各地的大楼随时都在不同程度上沉降。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean the building is going to fall in on itself.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着大楼会整体坍塌。

sentences.en: But there are certainly these other factors as they try to figure out like what went wrong here.
sentences.zh: 但当他们试图弄清楚这里究竟出了什么问题时，确实还有这些其他因素。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It feels there's a lot that we don't quite know yet, but it feels like one thing that we
sentences.zh: 感觉还有很多我们尚不清楚的事情，但我们从这座大楼倒塌事件中迅速了解到的其中一件事是，

sentences.en: did quickly learn from the story of this building's collapse is that a lot of the responsibility
sentences.zh: 评估这座大楼的结构完整性并对其进行处理的很大一部分责任，实际上掌握在其自身居民手中，对吧？

sentences.en: for evaluating the structural integrity of this building and dealing with it is really in the hands of its own residents, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一个自我监管的故事。

sentences.en: It's a story of self-policing.
sentences.zh: 我要冒昧地说一句，管理那个公寓董事会的人可能不是结构工程师，他们也并非全都是建筑师。

sentences.en: And I'm going to go out on a limb and say that the people who ran that condo board were probably not structural engineers and they were not all architects.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们发现有问题时，他们只能凭经验去猜测自己需要以多快的速度采取行动。

sentences.en: And so when they discover something's wrong, they're taking educated guesses about how quickly they need to act.
sentences.zh: 回想起来看起来很慢的时间表，对他们来说可能显得非常合理。

sentences.en: And what looks in retrospect like a slow timetable might have seemed very reasonable to them.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你在报道中是否也发现了这一点：人们正在质疑，到底有多少决策最终是由居住在这座大楼里的

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's something you're finding in your reporting that people are questioning just how much of this ended up being a decision made by the people who live in
sentences.zh: 居民作出的。

sentences.en: this building.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个重点，因为居民在我们的报道中告诉我们，他们认为这个问题应该追溯得更早。

sentences.en: I think that's an important point because what the residents have told us in our reporting is they think the question should go further back.
sentences.zh: 为什么在2018年收到一份告诉你存在需要数百万美元来修复的重大问题的报告之前，大楼没有得到更好的维护？

sentences.en: Why wasn't the building better maintained before you got to the point in 2018 where you had a report telling you that you had major problems that were
sentences.zh: 一个街区外有一栋姊妹楼，大约在同一时期由同一建筑商采用相同设计建造，并没有出现同样的问题，而该栋楼的居民

sentences.en: going to take millions of dollars to repair?
sentences.zh: 将此归因于随着时间的推移进行了更好的维护。

sentences.en: There is a sister building a block away, built around the same time by the same builder with the same design, that has not had the same probleMs. And the residents
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: of that building attribute that to just better upkeep over time.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕蒂，现在这座大楼、救援过程、潜在的诉讼和调查将会怎么样？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 居民已经针对公寓董事会提起诉讼。

sentences.en: So Patty, what happens now with this building, with this rescue process, with potentially litigation and investigations?
sentences.zh: 我想随着日子的推移，我们会在法庭上看到更多此类行动。

sentences.en: Lawsuits are already being filed by residents against the condo board.
sentences.zh: 救援现场有凶杀案侦探。

sentences.en: And I imagine we will see more of that activity in the courts as the days go on.
sentences.zh: 为什么是凶杀案？

sentences.en: We have homicide detectives on the scene of the rescue.
sentences.zh: 为了收集可能最终导致（你知道的）如果刑事法庭对这些死亡事件采取行动的证据。

sentences.en: Why homicide?
sentences.zh: 联邦紧急事务管理局来到这里是为了帮助幸存者重新安置并寻找新的住处。

sentences.en: To collect evidence that might lead to eventual, you know, if there is action in the criminal courts about these deaths.
sentences.zh: 因此，各种事情正在同时进行，但根据所有官方说法，目前的重点必须仍然是搜寻失踪人员。

sentences.en: The Federal Emergency Management Agency is here to help the survivors relocate and find new places to live.
sentences.zh: 在他们这样做的同时，他们会把其他一切都放在次要地位。

sentences.en: So various things are going on at once, but the focus, according to all of the authorities, has to remain for now in finding the missing.
sentences.zh: 每天每隔四个小时，他们都会前往现场附近的格兰德海滩酒店内部的一个宴会厅，试图向这些

sentences.en: And while they do that, they're going to put everything sort of on a secondary plane.
sentences.zh: 默默聚集在一起的家属提供信息，此时一名官员站在画架后方的麦克风前，试图告诉他们取得了什么进展。

sentences.en: And every day they're going to go in every four hours to the Grand Beach Hotel near the site, inside a ballroom, to try to give information to these
sentences.zh: 而且进展从来都不大。

sentences.en: families who are sort of gathered in silence as an official stands behind a microphone with an easel in the back and tries to tell them what progress has been made.
sentences.zh: 从星期四开始一直到现在都是这样，未来几天甚至几周可能也会继续这样，因为从搜救过渡到搜寻和打捞失踪人员的过程是如此痛苦且缓慢。

sentences.en: And it's never a lot.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And that's what's been happening since Thursday and probably what's going to continue to happen
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: for the days and maybe weeks to come, because this process is so painful and so slow as they move from search and rescue to search and recovery of the missing.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Patti, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
